findings: `summary.text` and `learner.overview.text` say 牛 is “a picture of an ox’s head and horns” / “pictures an ox’s head and horns,” but the selected image is identified as a later seal-style rendering and the sources describe the head-and-horns analysis for earlier inscriptional forms.
